description: Defaults and guardrails for product-marketing keyword research.
workflow: Define the product, audience, market, and reader problem.
Collect seed language from customers, support, sales, and product documentation.
Expand candidates with related questions, modifiers, and competitor terminology.
Classify intent and compare free Google Trends interest for each promising candidate.
Select one primary query and a small set of supporting queries with distinct content jobs.
Record evidence, content gaps, difficulty assumptions, and a recommended content angle.
